notes.title: Raiden IV x MIKADO remix and RAIDEN III x MIKADO MANIAX Deluxe Edition Discounts
notes.content:
Two legendary side-scrolling shoot-’em-ups, two incredible discounts! Enjoy classic arcade action with a host of modern features in both [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2002860/Raiden_III_x_MIKADO_MANIAX/]Raiden III x MIKADO MANIAX[/url][/i] and [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2002850/Raiden_IV_x_MIKADO_remix/?curator_clanid=247472]Raiden IV x MIKADO remix[/url][/i]! Both titles contain original and remixed background music, multiple game modes, and Double Play, with each having their own exclusive set of additional content, such as Overkill mode in [i]Raiden IV x MIKADO remix[/i] and the World Rankings in [i]Raiden III x MIKADO MANIAX[/i].

Take advantage of [i]Raiden III x MIKADO MANIAX's[/i] launch on Steam with the following discounts, going on now until September 13. 

First off, the [i]Raiden IV & Raiden III x MIKADO[/i] Deluxe Edition Bundle allows you to save on both titles and experience the ultimate modern [i]Raiden[/i] experience!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31358/Raiden_IV__Raiden_III_x_MIKADO_Deluxe_Edition/][i]Raiden IV & Raiden III x MIKADO[/i] Deluxe Edition Bundle[/url]: $59.82 (14.5% off)[/list]

And for those of you who have already purchased [i]Raiden IV x MIKADO remix[/i], you can get the Deluxe Edition of [i]Raiden III x MIKADO MANIAX[/i] for its cheapest price yet!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31357/Raiden_III_x_MIKADO_MANIAX_Deluxe_Edition/][i]Raiden III x MIKADO MANIAX[/i] Deluxe Edition[/url] (for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2002850/Raiden_IV_x_MIKADO_remix/?curator_clanid=247472][i]Raiden IV x MIKADO remix[/i][/url] owners): $28.33 (19% off)
